comparison.objective: Cap and shake a cocktail shaker, then return it upright without losing contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Use one hand to retain a cap while the other supports a vessel through repeated high-amplitude reversals.
comparison.success_condition: Capped shaker tipped and reversed at least four times, all beads retained, and tin returned upright.
comparison.reason: This is bimanual closure retention during dynamic shaking, not fine adjustment, tool reacquisition, or impact-stop commissioning.
